about: Real job titles labelled by hand (2026-10-21): is it a software-development role? Regression fixture for jbIsDeveloperTitle. Sources: Indeed country sites (de/fr/nl/pl/es/it/se/dk/fi/cz/at/be/pt/ie/hu/ro/gr/no/ch, uk/www/ca) read through web-search snippets of their remote/home-office result pages, because the Indeed connector stayed rate-limited for this whole run; plus Indeed API (search_jobs, remote) titles fetched earlier on 2026-10-21 for the marketing fixture (DE FR NL PL IT ES SE IE PT AT BE CZ GB); plus ZipRecruiter API (remote, US). 'source' gives the Indeed country (or MKT / US-ZR) each title came from. Independent check (2026-10-21): 1 relabel (QShield -> developer) and 77 added real titles. The Indeed connector stayed rate-limited for the checker too (about 30 calls, 12:30-12:42 UTC, none answered), so added titles tagged <CC>-WS were read from Indeed result/browse pages through web search (MA-WS = ma.indeed.com, French-language) and <CC>-WEB come from other job boards (real postings, kept for false friends and developer words the fixture had no example of).
